about.hero_intro: Full-stack web developer currently based <1>near Taranto, Italy</1>, and originally from <2>New York City</2>.
about.hero_description_2: Travel led me to freelance work, giving me the freedom to explore new places while helping small businesses build and maintain their websites.
about.hero_description_3: I build responsive websites with React and TypeScript that help clients reach their audiences.
about.hero_description_4: I’ve worked with React since 2020, combining frontend development with the backend work small businesses need to move beyond static sites.

frontend.title: Front-End Developer
bullets: Delivered and maintained 12+ responsive websites and React applications, handling development, deployment, and ongoing support.
Updated legacy HTML, CSS, and JavaScript codebases with React, Next.js, and TypeScript, making them easier to maintain and extend.
Built reusable, accessible components with Tailwind CSS and added automated checks with Vitest, React Testing Library, and Playwright.
Integrated REST APIs and headless CMS platforms so clients could update content themselves, reducing routine support requests.

audio_mastering.title: Audio Mastering Consultant
bullets: Edited, restored, mastered, and synchronized voice-over audio for five YouTube videos each week, keeping sound consistent and meeting publishing deadlines.
Mastered raw voice-over to meet ACX requirements and produced audio assets for public-service announcements used by a U.S. state government and educational language-learning applications.

it_intern.title: IT Support I Intern
bullets: Upgraded staff PCs and computer labs from Windows 7 to Windows 10, and set up hardware and networked peripherals.
Resolved Tier-1 technical support tickets using G Suite, Microsoft 365, and remote tools while managing Active Directory accounts and local networking.

invoice.title: InVoice
invoice.shortDesc: Turns voice-over scripts into itemized invoices with per-character word counts and exports to PDF, DOCX, and plain text.
invoice.fullDesc: InVoice helps voice actors turn scripts into accurate invoices. It parses character dialogue, counts billable words, applies reusable rate presets, and exports PDF, DOCX, and plain-text invoices so performers spend less time on admin.
features: Parses scripts into per-character word counts for faster billing prep.
Built accessible workflows with Mantine UI components.
Used Zustand to keep single-document and multi-document tools in sync.
Added reusable rate presets and export to PDF, DOCX, and plain text.
invoice.previewAlt: InVoice dashboard showing script parser, character word counts, and invoice preview

portfolio.title: Portfolio Website v2
portfolio.shortDesc: A bilingual Astro and React portfolio with tested navigation, contact flow, and static deployment.
portfolio.fullDesc: A bilingual Astro and React portfolio with localized routes, accessible interactions, and React islands for interactive sections.
features: Shipped 11 static routes with EN/IT localization and browser-language detection.
Built keyboard-accessible navigation, modals, and contact validation with Playwright tests.
Added a light/dark theme and Framer Motion animations.
Set up Netlify deployment, honeypot spam protection, and security headers.
portfolio.previewAlt: Portfolio site with navigation, bilingual tabs, and experience timeline
